findings.summary: For self-employed users the calculator gives no amount for withdrawing before 6 years, so half of what the reader came for is missing. This means self-employed mode exists, so it is not the switch doing nothing.
Numbers show at years 4 and 5 over empty dashed boxes, so they look like real answers when they may not be. This could mislead.
The back-to-top button covers the label of the last result bar. This is a layout annoyance.
The term 'מסלול מדד' is used without explanation, and the reader confused it with the price index.
The pink 'before 6 years: tax' label and the grey labels have poor contrast on the dark background. The complaint is about readability, not about the line appearing or the chart jumping.
The 7% yearly return is pre-filled with no context on whether it is realistic. This is a wish for more information.
